craft.label: Behind the craft
craft.titleSub: How I actually work — human plus AI
craft.lede: I'm Wahyu — 14 years keeping enterprise infrastructure alive, and a certified tech enthusiast who spends his nights deep in everything AI: agentic security operations, vibe-coded apps and games, social media tooling, and automating anything that smells manual. The CV is the formal version; this is the fun one.

steps.s: Assessment, dependency mapping and a migration sequence that survives contact with production.
Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell — if it happens twice, it becomes code.
Zero Trust, least privilege, EDR/XDR — security is architecture, not an add-on.
RPO/RTO drills and cutover rehearsals before anyone depends on the system.
Documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer — no hero dependency.

craft.quoteWho: Wahyu Budi Prastowo / Cloud Infrastructure Architect

journey.label: The journey

items.body: Migration and modernization programs, Azure Stack Hub (HPE → Lenovo), Microsoft 365 for ~500 users, disaster recovery for 700+ VMs and hybrid identity security — with ~IDR 2.9B in cumulative efficiency gains.
200+ servers held at 99.99% uptime, fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure for mobile games serving millions of concurrent users, and a P2V migration that cut the hardware footprint by 40%.
Multi-branch BGP / OSPF network across 50+ Cisco and MikroTik devices, downtime down 45%, plus secure low-latency VPN links between Indonesia, Korea and China.
200+ Linux / Windows servers across three enterprise entities and broadcast-grade live streaming with FFmpeg, Wowza and Darwin — including core streaming for Metro TV's digital expansion.
Where it all started — networks, servers and a taste for breaking things until they make sense.

wins.wt: Terraform & DevOps workflows on Google Cloud

journey.winsNote: Plus Linux Foundation tracks (GitOps, Cilium, OWASP Top 10, Serverless), Acronis Cloud Tech (DR, M365, MDR/XDR) and Microsoft Purview / Sentinel workshops.
